title: The Maid I Hired Recently is Mysterious
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Yuuri, a young boy from a rich family, lives in a large estate after his parents die in a car accident and is cared for by his new maid Lilith, a teenager who once had ties to his parents. Convinced her beauty and perfection must be some kind of magic, he keeps 'investigating' her, and his unwitting confessions of attraction fluster her as a bond grows; a classmate, Tsukasa, cheers on their 'forbidden relationship' (Wikipedia, cached; Yen Press blurb via AniList).
life_message: Care and companionship can fill the gap left by loss, and honest feelings disarm teasing.
